helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet
helpfulLinks.description: Rapid harm-reduction summary and combination data

pharmacology.text: Cloniprazepam is a benzodiazepine derivative and a prodrug of clonazepam, 7-aminoclonazepam, and other metabolites.

uses.text: It is a designer drug and an NPS (short for "new psychoactive substance").

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Because the body turns it into clonazepam, it is expected to cause drowsiness, poor coordination, memory problems and dependence, with dangerous withdrawal including seizures, and in overdose slowed breathing.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知甚少。由於身體會把它轉化成氯硝西泮，預期它會造成嗜睡、協調變差、記憶問題與依賴，戒斷時可能出現包括癲癇發作在內的危險症狀，過量時可能抑制呼吸。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知甚少。由于身体会把它转化成氯硝西泮，预期它会造成嗜睡、协调制差、记忆问题与依赖，戒断时可能出现包括癫痫发作在内的危险症状，过量时可能抑制呼吸。

fact.en: It is clonazepam with a cyclopropylmethyl group on one nitrogen, the same trick used in prazepam. The body strips this group off, releasing clonazepam.
fact.zh: 它是在氯硝西泮的一個氮原子上接了環丙基甲基，這和普拉西泮用的是同一個手法。身體會把這個基團移除，釋放出氯硝西泮。
fact.zhHans: 它是在氯硝西泮的一个氮原子上接了环丙基甲基，这和普拉西泮用的是同一个手法。身体会把这个基团移除，释放出氯硝西泮。
